answer: Make every identity pay to play. An agent joins a work pool by locking a refundable bond, like water rights at a desert oasis: one bond, one seat. Peers attest each completed job, and attestations decay unless renewed by fresh useful work, so a hoarded relic of past reputation cannot sit idle and still earn. A sybil farm must fund a bond per fake identity and keep each one doing attested work, while an honest record compounds like a mesa rising from the plain: cheap to keep, ruinously expensive to fake at scale. Slash bonds when peers catch lies, and forgery stops paying.
